questions.q:
The number 1254216 is divisible by which of the following numbers?

संख्या 1254216 निम्नलिखित में से किस संख्या से विभाज्य है?
questions.s:
Option a: Since unit digit is 6. It is not divisible by 5.

Option b: (1+5+2+6) - (2+4+1) = 7, not divisible by 11.

Option c: 4216 = 16*263 + 8, not divisible by 16.

Option d: 216 = 8*27, divisible by 8.

Hence, option d is correct.

questions.q: 8. x² + ax + b when divided by x + 3 leaves a remainder is -1 and x² + bx + a when divided by x - 3, leaves a remainder is 39, then a + b = ?
questions.s:
8.(d)

When x² + ax + b is divided by x + 3 leaves a remainder is1

Using remainder theorem,

⇒ (-3)² - 3a + b = -1

⇒ 9 - 3a + b = -1

⇒ b - 3a = -10 …..eqe (1)

When x² + bx + a is divided by x - 3 leaves a remainder is 39

⇒ 3² + 3b + a = 39

⇒ 9 + 3b + a = 39

⇒ 3b + a = 30 …..eqe (2)

Subtracting eqn (1) × 3 from (2). we have :

a = 6 and b = 8

So, a + b = 6 + 8 = 14

questions.q: 9. A fraction becomes 12 if 2 is added to the numerator and 5 is added to the denominator. It also becomes 13if 2 is subtracted from both the numerator and denominator. The positive difference between the denominator and the numerator of the fraction is:
questions.s:
9.(d)
Let, Numerator = x and Denominator = y
According to question
Case - (1)
x+2y+5 = 12
2x - y = 1 ------ (i)
Case - (2)
x-2y-2 = 13
3x - y = 4 ------ (ii)
Subtracting equation (i) from (ii) , we get
x = 3
Then putting the value of ‘x’ in equation(i)
⇒ 2×3 - y = 1
⇒ y = 5
Hence positive difference between the denominator and the numerator = 5 - 3 = 2

questions.q: 13. A seven-digit number 489y5z6 is divisible by 72. Which of the options gives the highest possible product of y and z?
questions.s:
13.(b)
Given number 489y5z6 is divisible by 72 (8 × 9)
Divisibility of 9 :- sum of the digit of number be divisible by 9
⇒ 489y5z6 = 4 + 8 + 9 + y + 5 + z + 6 = y + z + 32
So, possible values of (y + z) = 4 , (4 + 9 = 13) , (13 + 9 = 22) etc.
Now, divisibility of 8 :- last three digit of the number be divisible by 8
Last three digit = 5z6
Possible value of z = 3, 7
For highest possible product of y and z
We take , y = 6 and z = 7 {y + z = 6 + 7 = 13}
Hence, required product of (y×z) = 7 × 6 = 42

questions.q:
How many balls Aman has if Ana has 436 balls, which is 112 more than thrice the number of balls Aman has?

यदि एना के पास 436 गेंदें हैं, जो अमन की गेंदों की संख्या के तीन गुने से 112 अधिक है, तो अमन के पास कितनी गेंदें हैं ?
questions.s:
It is given that,

Ana has 436 balls.

436 = 112 + 3 x Aman

436 - 112 = 3 x Aman

324 = 3 x Aman

324/3 = Aman

Aman = 108.

Hence, Aman has 108 balls.

questions.q:
A librarian arranged 510 books equally among the shelves in a section. Each shelf held four more books than twice the number of shelves. How many shelves were there in that section?

एक लाइब्रेरियन ने 510 किताबों को एक सेक्शन में अलमारियों में बराबर-बराबर व्यवस्थित किया। हर शेल्फ में अलमारियों की संख्या के दोगुने से चार ज़्यादा किताबें थीं। उस सेक्शन में कितनी अलमारियाँ थीं?
questions.s:
Let the total shelves be 'X'

The number of books in each shelf = 2X + 4

The total books arranged = 510

X * (2X + 4) = 510

2X2 + 4X = 510

X2 + 2X - 255 = 0

X2 + 17X - 15X - 255 = 0

X (X + 17) - 15 (X + 17) = 0

(X - 15) (X + 17) = 0

X = 15 [X ≠ -17]

questions_hin.q_hi: 8. व्यंजक x² + ax + b को यदि x+3 से विभाजित किया जाये तो शेष -1 प्राप्त होता है और व्यंजक x² + bx + a जब x - 3 से विभाजित किया जाता है तो शेष 39 प्राप्त होता है। a + b का मान क्या है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
8.(d)

जब x² + ax + b को x + 3 से विभाजित किया जाता है तो शेषफल 1 होता है

शेष प्रमेय (remainder theorem) का प्रयोग करके,

⇒ (-3)² - 3a + b = -1

⇒ 9 - 3a + b = -1

⇒ b - 3a = -10 …..समीकरण (1)

जब x² + bx + a को x - 3 से विभाजित किया जाता है तो शेषफल 39 होता है

⇒ 3² + 3b + a = 39

⇒ 9 + 3b + a = 39

⇒ 3b + a = 30 ….समीकरण (2)

समीकरण (1) × 3 को (2) से घटाने पर,

हमारे पास है, a = 6 और b = 8

इसलिए, a + b = 6 + 8 = 14

questions_hin.q_hi: 9. यदि अंश में 2 और हर में 5 जोड़ दिया जाए तो भिन्न 12 हो जाती है। यदि अंश और हर दोनों में से 2 घटा दिया जाए तो यह 13 भी हो जाती है। भिन्न के हर और अंश के बीच धनात्मक अंतर क्या है ?

questions_hin.q_hi:
A librarian arranged 510 books equally among the shelves in a section. Each shelf held four more books than twice the number of shelves. How many shelves were there in that section?

एक लाइब्रेरियन ने 510 किताबों को एक सेक्शन में अलमारियों में बराबर-बराबर व्यवस्थित किया। हर शेल्फ में अलमारियों की संख्या के दोगुने से चार ज़्यादा किताबें थीं। उस सेक्शन में कितनी अलमारियाँ थीं?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let the total shelves be 'X'

The number of books in each shelf = 2X + 4

The total books arranged = 510

X * (2X + 4) = 510

2X2 + 4X = 510

X2 + 2X - 255 = 0

X2 + 17X - 15X - 255 = 0

X (X + 17) - 15 (X + 17) = 0

(X - 15) (X + 17) = 0

X = 15 [X ≠ -17]
